findings.guide_says: Chimney & connector: at least once every two months in the heating season. No note; this is the only chimney-check interval the guide shows.
findings.manual_says: p. 25: "The chimney connector and chimney should be inspected at least once every two months during the heating season to determine if a creosote buildup has occurred." p. 30 (twice) and p. 31: "Your chimney should be checked and cleaned, if necessary, every few months." This is a silent pick: the manual gives two intervals for the same check. The writer listed it only in review.notes as a 'minor wording difference' and didn't show it on the page.
findings.fix:
Keep the p. 25 row and add after the kv block:
Note: p. 25 says to inspect the chimney connector and chimney at least once every two months during the heating season; the troubleshooting pages (pp. 30-31) say to have the chimney checked and cleaned, if necessary, every few months.
Record it in review.conflicts (class substantive).

findings.guide_says: Note: p. 19 says to leave the air open for 20-30 minutes after lighting, and p. 23 says to set it to high for 20 to 30 minutes when starting; the tips on p. 20 say to burn at high for 10-30 minutes when you start the stove.
findings.manual_says: p. 19 doesn't say 'after lighting'. Step 5: "After 15 minutes, or once the catalytic thermometer enters the active range, close the bypass control engaging the combustor (...). Leave the air control open for 20-30 minutes so that the fire becomes well established." Step 6: "After 20-30 minutes, begin to regulate the heat output and burn rate by sliding in the air control." On p. 19 the 20-30 minutes comes right after closing the bypass, which is also the order of the guide's own steps 5-6. So the note doesn't match the drawer, and it makes p. 19 read the same as p. 23. The p. 20 tips also say: "During the startup of a cold stove, a medium to high firing rate must be maintained for about 20 minutes."
findings.fix: Note: p. 19 says that once the bypass is closed, you leave the air control open for 20-30 minutes; p. 23 says to set it to high for 20 to 30 minutes when starting; the tips on p. 20 say to burn at high for 10-30 minutes when you start the stove, and to keep a medium to high firing rate for about 20 minutes when starting a cold stove.

findings.guide_says: Overall dimensions appear only as a dimensioned drawing for each model ... The drawing values aren't in the manual text, so they aren't transcribed here; read them from the drawing pages. The manual text doesn't state weights or firebox volume. There is no Maker's website note.
findings.manual_says: p. 6: "WOOD CLASSIC DIMENSIONAL DRAWINGS / All dimensions are in inches." p. 7: "ASHWOOD DIMENSIONAL DRAWINGS / All dimensions are in inches." p. 8: "CAMBRIDGE DIMENSIONAL DRAWINGS / All dimensions are in inches." These pages are drawings only, and no page of the text gives a weight or a firebox volume. website.json prints these figures: Ashwood LE-1 Width 26-1/8", Height with Legs 30", Height with Pedestal 32-1/2", Depth 24-1/8", Weight 440 lbs. Wood Classic LE-1 Width 26-1/8", Height with Legs 31-3/4", Height with Pedestal 34-1/4", Depth 26-1/8", Weight 450 lbs. Cambridge LE-1 Width 26-1/8", Height with Lower Platform 38", Height without Lower Platform 37", Depth 24-1/8", Weight 470 lbs. All three: Firebox Size 2.5 ft³. The GUIDE_SPEC website section says two things here. When the manual gives a figure only in a drawing, the website's figures go where the guide points to the drawing. When the guide says the manual prints no figure, the website's figure goes in a small note right there.
findings.fix:
After each model's drawing row, add a small note with that model's website figures, e.g.
Maker's website: Width 26-1/8"; Height with Legs 30"; Height with Pedestal 32-1/2"; Depth 24-1/8"; Weight 440 lbs.
for the Ashwood LE-1, and the same for the Wood Classic LE-1 and Cambridge LE-1 with their own values. After 'doesn't state weights or firebox volume', add
Maker's website: Firebox Size 2.5 ft³ (all three models).
Record these in review.catalog_mismatches.

findings.guide_says: Efficiency 77.8% (High Heating Value), followed only by 'Maker's website: Efficiency (HHV) 78%.'
findings.manual_says: p. 3: "an efficiency of 77.8% (High Heating Value)". The manual prints no LHV figure. For all three models, website.json also prints "Efficiency (LHV)": "84%", which is on a topic the guide covers, but the guide leaves it out.
findings.fix:
After the HHV note, add
Maker's website: Efficiency (LHV) 84%.

verdict: Safe to publish once these minor fixes are made: every safety procedure and value matches the manual exactly, and all 27 page links are correct. That covers the lighting and reload sequences, the over-fire, broken-glass and ash steps, the clearances, floor protection, chimney and flue heights, the mobile-home rules and the warranty.
